claims: All services and servers of Rec Room are closing on June 1, 2026.
Rec Room has operated for a decade.
Rec Room was once valued at $3.5 billion.
Rec Room failed to become sustainably profitable.
Costs exceeded revenue for Rec Room.
New account creation in Rec Room is no longer available.
Friend requests in Rec Room are no longer available.
New Rec Room+ (RR+) subscriptions are no longer available.
Creation of new monetized user-generated content (rooms, items, keys) in Rec Room is disabled.
Token rewards in Rec Room are stopped.
Existing RR+ memberships are extended until the June 1, 2026 closure.
Partnered Creators can still cash out tokens.
Registration for the partnered creator program stops on May 1, 2026.
Final token collection is allowed until May 18, 2026.
Creators can still manage their earnings until the final shutdown date.
Rec Room had major layoffs in 2025.
The layoffs occurred before the final closure announcement.
